title: Changing a customer's representative never changes its work orders
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have two active staff members at the test location with their "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A and sales rep B.
  • Create a customer for this test whose one Sales Representative is sales rep A.
  • Create an open, uninvoiced work order for that customer, with one approved labor line and one part, so that its one "Sales Representative" field reads sales rep A (copied from the customer when it was created).
  • Open the customer's Edit Customer window in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
custom_steps:
1. Change the Sales Representative field to sales rep B.
  2. Save the customer.
  3. Open the work order.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The field reads sales rep B.

Step 2:

  • The customer saves.

Step 3:

  • The work order still reads sales rep A.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-R30: “Changing a customer's representatives never changes its existing work orders or part sales. Only work orders and part sales created afterwards start with the new choice.”
